comment.comment:
Kardashev = the simplest bet on humanity's biggest story

Every major tech narrative right now (AI, energy, space) is really one story: civilization learning to harness more power. The Kardashev Scale is the scoreboard for that story.

	•	AI needs energy. The race for compute is already a race for gigawatts. That is Kardashev progress in real time.
	•	Space is the next step. Mars and a multiplanetary future are how a civilization moves from Type I toward Type II.
	•	Musk is already framing it this way. He has publicly talked about the Kardashev Scale as the measure of humanity's progress, which keeps the idea in front of millions of people.
	•	Acceleration creates attention. If AI speeds everything up, more people will look for a way to express that view, and Kardashev is the cleanest ticker for it.

My thesis: you don't have to pick the winner in AI, energy, or space. Kardashev is the narrative that sits above all three. As long as humanity keeps climbing the scale, the token stays relevant.
